purpose: Complete bounded dollar-cost publication without fabricating provider usage, billing, or token metadata.

openai.rejected_shortcut: Do not divide the $19.99 monthly subscription by an arbitrary request count and do not apply the agent-credit unit price to SV-RECON-001 without provider-observed binding.
openai.release_condition: A provider-facing record exposes request-specific cost, exact token usage plus a bound versioned rate card, or provider-observed quota allocation tied to SV-RECON-001 and candidate-inputs/openai.json.

anthropic.release_condition: A cost-evidence/anthropic-*.json record exists, binds to SV-RECON-001 and candidate-inputs/anthropic.json, identifies its evidence mode and source observation, uses no non-TV/TVC secret/token, and yields a non-null bounded provider cost with basis disclosure.

deepseek.release_condition: A cost-evidence/deepseek-*.json record exists, binds to SV-RECON-001 and candidate-inputs/deepseek.json, identifies its evidence mode and source observation, uses no non-TV/TVC secret/token, and yields a non-null bounded provider cost with basis disclosure.

rejected_evidence: estimated token counts not reported by provider billing/usage surfaces
word counts treated as provider tokens
subscription sticker price without a provider-observed allocation or quota-consumption basis
historical request cost from a different task/model represented as this request cost
fabricated provider response IDs, latency, usage, invoice values, or API charges
provider API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, or other non-TV/TVC protected secrets
machine_release_condition: All three incomplete provider cost-evidence records validate and the canonical run emits zero cost blockers; hosted run/job/log/artifact inspection then determines bounded publication readiness.
next_action: Observe provider-facing Anthropic and DeepSeek cost/usage evidence and any stronger OpenAI request-specific usage surface if available; install only admissible evidence records; candidate behavioral outputs do not need to be rerun at providers.
archive_rationale: The remaining cost evidence has explicit owners, accepted evidence modes, rejection rules, file destinations, and machine-observable release conditions; no chat-only information is required.
